summary: Frontend-only retest of POS after the 'ReferenceError: att is not defined' fix. I logged in with the real Owner account (baa) for smoke tests: /pos opens both directly and through navigation (sidebar nav-category-pos then category-tabs-dropdown, and on mobile bottomnav-pos then dropdown). No pageerror on desktop (1920x1080) or mobile (390x844). pos-page is visible, and with no Rider selected absen-button and eod-button are both disabled. All Rider, stock, attendance and EOD flows used test-only browser fixtures (page.route). The app code is not mocked. 46/46 assertions passed across the full run and the EOD rerun. Confirmed: Absen enabled and EOD disabled when attendance is empty. checkin-button is disabled until there is a 6-digit PIN (non-digits are stripped, max 6) and a photo. One checkin POST closes the dialog, the button shows 'Sudah Absen' disabled and EOD becomes enabled without reload. The Absen dialog cannot be reopened. pos-rider-select is in the header and still works after attendance. Status is kept separate per rider. After reload, existing attendance enables EOD and disables Absen without opening the dialog. A delayed (3s) response for Rider A after switching to Rider B does not leak A's status into B. While loading, attendance-loading shows and Absen/EOD are disabled. A failed GET shows attendance-load-error with both buttons disabled, and attendance-retry-button recovers. The si4am:data-changed event refetches attendance and keeps the PIN/photo draft and the cart (Rp 30.000). Cart and cart-total are correct. The EOD report opens, eod-close-button sends exactly one POST, the closed state shows, then pos-locked appears and products are disabled. No /api/sales POST was made.

ui_bugs.issue: After EOD close succeeds, the cart (pos-cart-floating-button 'Rp 30.000') stays visible while POS is locked. Checkout is correctly disabled, but the leftover cart is confusing. Consider clearing cart/bcart in closeEod.

issues: pick-rider-hint still says 'Klik tombol Absen untuk memilih rider', but the rider picker is now pos-rider-select in the header and Absen is disabled until a rider is chosen. Stale text.

The owner-pos-preview banner says products can be selected without a rider, but the product grid only renders when riderId is set, so no products appear. This existed before; outside the scope of this fix.

action_items: Optional: clear the cart in closeEod after a successful close (LOW)
Optional: update the pick-rider-hint text to point to the header rider select (LOW)
critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx: the fix is correct. The att/ready/onSaved props come from the parent, and the attendance effect uses an active-flag cleanup keyed on riderId/date/revision/retry, so stale responses are ignored. currentAttendance is matched on riderId+date, so no state leaks between riders.

The Attendance checkout button (attendance-checkout-button) can no longer be reached, because the Absen button is disabled once att exists and the dialog cannot reopen. This matches the 'absen sekali' rule, but the checkout branch is now dead code.
POS.jsx is 504 lines, which is acceptable. loadStock has no .catch, so a failed GET /pos/stock fails silently (pre-existing).
test_credentials: Real Owner baa from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (not printed). Login via full-URL page.request.post identify + login.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-only browser fixtures (page.route) were used for: GET /api/users?role=rider (FX Rider A/B), GET /api/attendance (with delay and fail modes), POST /api/attendance/checkin, GET /api/pos/stock, GET /api/payment-accounts/public, GET /api/customers/lookup, GET /api/sales/eod, POST /api/sales/eod/close. POST /api/sales is aborted. No real attendance, sales or EOD was written.
